summary: Per-frame AI timing update over the live vehicle array. Sets the half-distance flag, then for each vehicle not in states 3 or 2, checks a per-vehicle accumulated elapsed time (in a float array at vehicle-array-relative byte offset 8148208) and, when it is above a small threshold, computes the delta against offset 8148624, increments a lap counter at vehicle +16444, writes the clamped race time into vehicle +16536, writes the offset-adjusted race delta into vehicle +16568, forces vehicle state to 1, and re-sorts driver ordering via AIDriverSorting. Idle vehicles with state 0 are set to state 1. Ends by resetting the scoring ring-buffer globals (83EE54/58/5C to &unk_7D2E54, 8AAE64/68/6C to &unk_83EE64, counters zeroed) and returns &unk_83EE64.

local_names.v4: byte delta between this and the vehicle pointer array base
local_names.v7: elapsed delta between the two per-vehicle accumulators
local_names.v8: clamped race time = v7 + this[213], floored at 0
local_names.v9: vehicle pointer re-read for the idle state check

operations.description: Read the vehicle count from dword_5C329C into the loop bound v1 and snapshot it in v11; the loop runs while v2 < v1.
Iterate v2 over the live vehicle pointers dword_7C54F0[v2], computing v4 = this - dword_7C54F0 once so per-vehicle accumulator reads are addressed relative to the array base.
Read vehicle state at +16484; skip the timed update entirely when the state is 3 or 2 (retired/inactive classes).
Per-vehicle accumulated time at (v4 + 4*v2 + 8148208) must be greater than the zero threshold (the packet lists flt_59E440 as the read constant backing the literal 0.0).
v7 = accum[8148208] - accum[8148624]: elapsed delta between the two per-vehicle accumulator slots.
Increment the lap/segment counter at vehicle +16444.
v8 = v7 + this[213]; clamp v8 to >= 0.0.
Write the clamped race time into vehicle +16536 as a float.
Write vehicle +16568 = this[213] - flt_8ACF90 + v7 (time delta offset by the race-time offset global).
When the vehicle state at +16484 is not 3, force it to 1.
AIDriverSorting(v5): re-sort driver ordering after the lap/time update.
For vehicles whose state at +16484 is 0, force it to 1.
Reset the scoring ring-buffer globals: dword_83EE5C = dword_83EE58 = dword_83EE54 = (int)&unk_7D2E54, and dword_83EE60 = 0.
Reset the queue pointers: dword_8AAE6C = dword_8AAE68 = dword_8AAE64 = (int)&unk_83EE64, and dword_7D2E50 = 0.

unresolved: The per-vehicle accumulator array addressed as v4 + 4*v2 + 8148208 and 8148624 (byte offsets relative to the vehicle pointer array base) is rendered by Hex-Rays as absolute-ish offsets; their exact meaning is not established by the packet.

The vehicle struct offsets 16484 (state), 16444 (lap counter), 16536 (race time) and 16568 (offset delta) are not named in the packet; the existing fill names them at DERIVED trust only, not adopted here.
flt_59E440 is packet-listed as a read global but does not appear literally in the raw source; it is assumed to back the > 0.0 threshold literal.

The exact contents of unk_7D2E54 / unk_83EE64 and the roles of the ring-buffer globals (83EE54..83EE60, 8AAE64..8AAE6C, 7D2E50, 7D2E54) are not fully mapped; the existing fill labels them scoring/session structures at DERIVED trust.
The meaning of byte_8ACFA0 (existing fill: HalfDistanceFlag, DERIVED) is not independently evidenced.
The legacy ABI label AI_Tick_Update_Ring_Buffer_Reset (abi:lead) is narrower than the tick body; the canonical name AITickUpdate is kept.
